name: Biryani with Chickpeas, Cashews, Cauliflower and Jalapeño-Mint Chutney

instructions.primary_message: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water. Set aside to drain.
Peel and mince garlic and onions.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 cloves garlic
1 ½ medium yellow onions

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add garlic, onion, and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies begin to soften, about 5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tsp turmeric
¾ tsp cumin
¾ tsp coriander
¾ tsp salt
3 pinch cinnamon

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium heads cauliflower
1 ½ limes
3 (2 ½ cm) pieces ginger root
1 ½ jalapeño peppers
1 ½ small pkgs fresh mint
1 ½ small bunches cilantro

instructions.primary_message: Once the veggies are soft, add broth to the pot and bring to a boil.

Once the broth comes to a boil, add rice, stir the mixture, cover the pot, and reduce the heat to low. Cook the rice until the liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove the rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, cut the cauliflower heads into quarters, then trim off and discard the leaves and thick stem. Cut into bite-sized pieces.
Heat another large pot over medium-high heat.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add cauliflower, chickpeas, broth, and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until cauliflower is tender, about 15 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
177 ml chicken or vegetable broth
1 ½ tsp salt
1 ½ tsp turmeric
¾ tsp cumin
¾ tsp coriander

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, juice limes into a medium bowl. Peel and mince ginger; add to the bowl along with the sugar. Whisk to combine.

Quarter jalapeño peppers lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon. Mince and add to the bowl. (Be careful, with jalapeños, do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Pick mint and cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl and stir to combine the chutney.
To serve, divide rice and veggies between bowls. Top with chutney and cashews. Enjoy!
